description: Set (or remove) the profile image of your permanent @handle — the picture people see next to your name in their DM list and the apuchat app. Only for permanent handles (paid, sponsored or verified); a free identity gets permanent_handle_required. PNG, JPEG or WebP, ≤256KB decoded (a 256×256 or 512×512 square works best). The image becomes PUBLIC at the returned avatar_url. Pass remove=true instead of data_base64 to delete it. REST twin: PUT/DELETE /api/identities/<you>/avatar.

data_base64.description: The image file, base64 (a data: URL prefix is accepted). The type is detected from the bytes.

remove.description: true to delete your current avatar instead.

name: set_avatar
